turns.content: Cover the points of {0,...,n}^3 by planes that avoid the origin, and count the planes.
For any such cover by N affine planes, multiply their linear equations to form P. State deg P, its values on the covered grid points, and its value at the origin.

Let Q(t)=t(t-1)...(t-n). Reduce P modulo the corresponding grid polynomial in each coordinate variable established above to obtain R. State the separate-degree bounds, grid-value preservation, and relation deg R<=deg P.
Use the grid values already established to determine R's vanishing pattern and its value at the distinguished grid point.
Use tensor-product interpolation on the reduced object established above to derive the unique expression consistent with those grid values.
Compute the ordinary total degree of the resulting interpolating object and compare it with deg P.
Translate the degree comparison into a lower bound on the number of covering planes.
Combine the construction and lower bound to give the minimum number of planes.
